age.evidence: A total of 34 retrospectively collected, untreated primary breast tumor specimens from young women (<40), with an equal number of tumors from older women (≥60), matched by race and IHC subtypes (based on ER, PR, HER2, Ki67), were selected for study from the CBCP.

material_type.evidence: inferred: Tissue sections from OCT-embedded breast tumor specimens were cut at 10 µm thickness for DNA, RNA, and MS proteomics and at 8 µm for RPPA using a Leica 3050 S Cryostat (Leica Biosystems, Deer Park, IL) set to −30 °C, applied to polyethylene naphthalate (PEN) membrane slides (Leica Microsystems Inc., Deerfield, IL), and then stored at −80 °C until LMD was performed.
